# Quinn Brewer

> Marketing and communications leader working in brand strategy, web design,
> content, writing, and podcasting. Based in the United States, working with
> consultancies, nonprofits, and growing companies.

Quinn Brewer builds brands and the things that carry them: identity systems,
websites, campaigns, written work, and audio. The background is filmmaking and
visual storytelling, which is why the work tends to start with what a company
is actually trying to say rather than with a template.

## Pages

- [Home](https://www.quinnbrewer.com/): What Quinn does, and the shape of a
  working relationship.
- [About](https://www.quinnbrewer.com/about.html): Background, capabilities, and

  communications projects.
- [Library](https://www.quinnbrewer.com/library.html): Books, records, films,
  and podcasts worth keeping, with ratings and writeups.
- [Blog](https://www.quinnbrewer.com/blog.html): Notes on design, marketing,
  taste, and studio life.
- [Contact](https://www.quinnbrewer.com/contact.html): Start a project.
